BR-01: Each USER must have a unique user_id.
BR-02: In this version, a USER is specialized into CLIENT or FREELANCER; the two subtypes are distinct and disjoint.
BR-03: Each CLIENT can post many JOB records, but each JOB belongs to one CLIENT.
BR-04: Each JOB belongs to one JOB_CATEGORY, while one JOB_CATEGORY can contain many JOB records.
BR-05: A FREELANCER can have many SKILL records and a SKILL can belong to many FREELANCER records; the relationship is resolved through FREELANCER_SKILL.
BR-06: A JOB can receive many PROPOSAL records.
BR-07: A FREELANCER can submit many PROPOSAL records for different JOB records.
BR-08: A FREELANCER may not submit more than one PROPOSAL for the same JOB.
BR-09: Each PROPOSAL belongs to exactly one JOB and one FREELANCER.
BR-10: A JOB may have at most one PROPOSAL selected (offered) by the CLIENT at a time.

BR-11: An accepted PROPOSAL requires mutual consent: it must be selected by the CLIENT and subsequently confirmed by the FREELANCER to generate exactly one CONTRACT. A proposal that lacks this final confirmation from the freelancer does not create a CONTRACT.
BR-12: Each CONTRACT involves exactly one CLIENT and one FREELANCER.
BR-13: A CONTRACT can be divided into multiple MILESTONE records; each MILESTONE belongs to one CONTRACT.
BR-14: Each MILESTONE amount must be greater than 0, and the total milestone value must not exceed the CONTRACT value.
BR-15: A MILESTONE may trigger a PAYMENT only after its work status is marked as COMPLETED and approved by the CLIENT.
BR-16: Each PAYMENT explicitly records the transfer of funds from the CLIENT (payer_id) to the FREELANCER (payee_id) for one specific MILESTONE, using a designated payment method.
